title: AI Creative Lead
jobDescription:
<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Phone Pe Limited:</strong></p> <p>Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the Phone Pe digital payments app, was launched in Aug
2016. As of April 2025, Phone Pe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. Phone Pe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Phone Pe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance,&nbsp;Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode
- hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus App Store Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India,&nbsp;which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to&nbsp;accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Culture:</strong></p> <p>At Phone Pe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right&nbsp; thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. Phone Pe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of&nbsp; the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!</p> <p><video controls="controls" width="300" height="150"> <source src="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mk Zstu Tl MFTM8s Dh1x4NYm7WSLueqklb/view?resourcekey"></video></p></div><h3><strong>The Mandate</strong></h3> <p>Phone Pe Group is building one of India’s first fully AI-native marketing organizations. We are not just looking for someone to experiment with AI. We want a leader who will change how our team of over 100 marketers thinks, works, and delivers. The AI Creative Head is the architect of this transformation. You will own the strategy, infrastructure, and culture change needed to empower every marketer at Phone Pe. You will build a team of AI specialists, create the playbook, and set the metrics. You will be accountable for measurable improvements in marketing speed, creative quality, and operational efficiency. This is a strategic leadership role, not just a hands-on position. You will report directly to the HOD and help design the future of our marketing.</p> <h3><strong>Core Competencies</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Visionary Curiosity:</strong> You anticipate AI trends rather than just tracking them. You have been building with AI tools since the early days. You can see where the industry will be in a year and prepare the organization to get there first.</li> <li><strong>Focus on Architecture:</strong> You have moved beyond simple prototyping. You think in terms of scalable workflows, governance frameworks, and team structures that will last.</li> <li><strong>Executive Influence:</strong> You can confidently explain to senior leadership why AI needs budget, headcount, and strategic priority. You focus on business outcomes instead of just tool features.</li> <li><strong>Culture Engineering:</strong> You understand that new tools fail without a change in mindset. You have successfully built cultures of experimentation in the past.</li> <li><strong>Innovation with Accountability:</strong> You push boundaries while measuring everything. You can link every AI initiative to time saved, revenue growth, or improved quality.</li> <li><strong>Macro Understanding:</strong> You have a deep understanding of consumer behavior. You can spot cultural shifts and turn them into marketing strategies that connect with our diverse users.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You Will Own</strong></h3> <p><strong> AI Transformation Strategy &amp; Roadmap</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define the annual AI adoption plan for the entire marketing organization.</li> <li>Identify and prioritize the most impactful AI use cases based on feasibility and team readiness.</li> <li>Build the business case for AI integration by projecting efficiency gains, resource optimization, and quality improvements.</li> <li>Share quarterly progress and recommendations with executive leadership using clear metrics.</li> </ul> <p><strong> Building &amp; Leading the Team</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hire and develop a team of AI specialists and prompt engineers to work alongside marketing squads.</li> <li>Design the best organizational structure for the AI function.</li> <li>Create performance frameworks and career paths for this entirely new team.</li> </ul> <p><strong> AI Infrastructure &amp; Tooling Ecosystem</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage the marketing AI stack by evaluating and integrating tools like language models, image generators, and workflow automation.</li> <li>Build and maintain a central playbook containing prompt libraries, workflow templates, and compliance guidelines.</li> <li>Design workflows using tools like N8N, Zapier, Make, and custom APIs to automate marketing tasks.</li> <li>Set up quality control processes, including brand safety checks and human review for AI-generated content.</li> </ul> <p><strong> Cross-Functional Enablement &amp; Change Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Run a structured training program with onboarding, skill assessments, and ongoing learning for over 100 marketers.</li> <li>Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Legal teams to ensure tools are compliant and scalable.</li> <li>Track adoption metrics closely, including active usage, completion rates, and team satisfaction.</li> <li>Act as the internal champion for AI transformation by presenting at meetings and building excitement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Creative &amp; Performance Impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive measurable improvements in creative output speed and campaign iteration.</li> <li>Work with performance marketing leads to integrate AI into media buying and creative optimization.</li> <li>Collaborate with brand and content teams to produce higher-quality content faster while protecting brand integrity.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Skills Required</strong></h3> <p><strong>Gen AI Mastery</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have built reliable, production-grade AI workflows at scale.</li> <li>You have deep experience with language models like GPT, Claude, and Gemini.</li> <li>You are experienced with image generation tools like Midjourney and DALL-E, and video tools like Runway.</li> <li>You understand prompt engineering, architecture frameworks, and when to build versus buy.</li> <li>You can quickly evaluate new AI tools and make confident decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Marketing Domain Depth</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 8 to 12 or more years of marketing experience across areas like performance marketing, brand strategy, or growth.</li> <li>You have managed large-scale marketing operations with high budgets and teams of over 10 people.</li> <li>You understand the full marketing stack, including paid media, CRM platforms, analytics, and creative production.</li> <li>Experience in fintech or high-growth consumer apps is highly preferred.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership &amp; Stakeholder Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a proven track record of building teams in fast-moving environments.</li> <li>You can communicate clearly and effectively with executives and the board.</li> <li>You are an expert in change management and driving the adoption of new processes.</li> <li>You collaborate seamlessly with technical and legal teams without needing close supervision.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Mindset to Succeed</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Total Ownership:</strong> You take responsibility for the outcome of AI transformation across the entire marketing organization. If a team is not adopting AI, you step in to help them.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Comfort with Ambiguity:</strong> You thrive in a constantly changing landscape where there is no existing playbook. You are energized by building processes from scratch. You make strong decisions with incomplete information and adjust quickly.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Systems Thinking:</strong> You focus on building repeatable systems and frameworks that solve problems across the entire organization.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Ideal Candidate Profile</strong></h3> <ul> <li>8 to 12 or more years in marketing, with at least 2 to 3 years leading teams of 5 or more.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building AI workflows and automation systems.</li> <li>Proven success in driving process or culture changes across an organization of over 100 people.</li> <li>A strong builder's mindset.</li> <li>A background in fintech, consumer tech, or high-growth digital businesses.</li> <li>Public speaking experience or published thought leadership on AI in marketing is a bonus.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why This Role Matters</strong></h3> <p>This is not just an innovation experiment. Phone Pe believes AI-native marketing will be a major competitive advantage over the next three years. The AI Creative Head will be the leader who makes this happen. You will have the resources, budget, and executive support to change how one of India's largest consumer tech companies operates. If you want to build a new function from the ground up with real ambition, this is the opportunity.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Phone Pe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Insurance Benefits
- </strong>Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance</li> <li><strong>Wellness Program -</strong> Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System</li> <li><strong>Parental Support
- </strong>Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program</li> <li><strong>Mobility Benefits
- </strong>Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy</li> <li><strong>Retirement Benefits
- </strong>Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Other Benefits
- </strong>Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><em>Our inclusive culture promotes individual expression, creativity, innovation, and achievement and in turn helps us better understand and serve our customers. We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity,&nbsp; ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. Phone Pe is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to treating all its employees and job applicants equally; regardless of&nbsp; gender, sexual preference, religion, race, color or disability. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or reasonable accommodation, during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, </em></strong><a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIp QLSc-ETchy2Ls Q_Djl NXOUc Gf I182Dn A533YZTLf Vw5Tk JH-Stw/viewform"><strong><em>please fill out this form.</em></strong></a></p> <p><strong><em>Read more about Phone Pe</em></strong><a href="https://www.phonepe.com/blog/"><strong><em> on our blog</em></strong></a><strong><em>.</em></strong></p> <p><a href="https://www.phonepe.com/blog/life-at-phonepe/"><strong>Life at Phone Pe</strong></a></p> <p><a href="https://www.phonepe.com/press/"><strong>Phone Pe in the news</strong></a></p></div>

As our AI Video Specialist, you are the master of the final render. You are a <strong>Video Creator</strong> first. Your role is to bridge the gap between a scripted idea and a world class visual reality by orchestrating a complex, AI first production pipeline. You aren't just cutting footage: you are navigating the latent space to synthesize high fidelity, cinematic content that sets a new industry standard.</p> <p><strong>The Craft (The Hybrid Approach)</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Neural Storytelling:</strong> You own the edit. Beyond just running models, you are responsible for the narrative flow, the emotional beats, and the hook-driven pacing required for modern platforms. You use AI to generate the assets, but you use your creator's instinct to assemble the story and ensure the human element remains front and center.</li> <li><strong>Orchestrate Node-Based Logic:</strong> You will spend the majority of your time in <strong>Comfy UI</strong>, building custom, repeatable pipelines. You design workflows and style transfers that allow us to scale our production without losing creative control.</li> <li><strong>Multi-Model Synthesis:</strong> You don't rely on a single tool. You know how to take a base generation from an open source model like <strong>LTX</strong>, <strong>Flux</strong>, or <strong>Wan (Qwen)</strong> and refine it using the high fidelity outputs of proprietary engines like <strong>Higgsfield</strong>.</li> <li><strong>Master Temporal Consistency:</strong> You design workflows that ensure stable, flicker free motion, maintaining character and environmental integrity across every frame of a production.</li> <li><strong>Cinematic Finishing:</strong> You provide the final human touch. This includes advanced color science, sound design, and audio-visual synchronization to ensure the final output feels like a high-budget production, not a generic AI clip.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The AI Technical Stack</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Local and Open Source:</strong> Comfy UI, Flux.1, LTX-2.3 Video, Wan 2.7 (Qwen) models.</li> <li><strong>Cloud and Proprietary:</strong> Higgsfield Cinema Studio 3.5, Kling O3, See Dance 2.0.</li> <li><strong>Control and Precision:</strong> Control Nets, IP-Adapters, and specialized temporal upscaling nodes.</li> <li><strong>Enhancement:</strong> Neural upscalers like Topaz and AI-driven audio cleanup tools.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You’ll be a great fit if…</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You are a Filmmaker at heart.</strong> You understand the visual grammar of cinema: pacing, lighting, and composition. You know how to steer AI models to achieve those professional standards.</li> <li><strong>You think in data-flows.</strong> You understand the technical why behind a result, from sampler choice to CFG scales, and you can debug a complex node-based error in minutes.</li> <li><strong>You are a Researcher-Creator.</strong> You are comfortable navigating Git Hub, managing Python environments, and staying ahead of the latest paper to code releases in the open source world.</li> <li><strong>You are obsessed with Automation.</strong> You don’t want to fix a single shot: you want to build a workflow that fixes the next thousand shots automatically.</li> <li><strong>You have a High Ownership Mindset.</strong> You are the final wall of defense for the soul of the video. Cross-Border Regulatory Compliance &amp; Advisory</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Interpret and implement cross-border regulatory frameworks including FEMA, RBI Master Directions, Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS), Export/Import guidelines, and foreign exchange guidelines.</li> <li>Provide regulatory advisory on cross-border payment flows such as:</li> <ul> <li>Inbound and outbound remittances</li> <li>Merchant cross-border collections</li> <li>Card-based international transactions</li> <li>FX conversion and settlement models</li> </ul> <li>Assess permissibility of cross-border use cases, structures, and partnerships under applicable regulations.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>2. Regulatory Change Management &amp; Prioritization</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Track regulatory developments across India and relevant foreign jurisdictions impacting cross-border products.</li> <li>Conduct regulatory impact assessments for new RBI circulars, FEMA notifications, and supervisory communications.</li> <li>Prioritize regulatory changes based on risk, business impact, and implementation timelines.</li> <li>Drive timely implementation of regulatory changes across systems, processes, and documentation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>3. Product &amp; Business Partnership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Work closely with Product and Business teams during ideation and launch of cross-border products to ensure regulatory alignment.</li> <li>Review and challenge product flows, fund movement, and FX structures to ensure compliance with regulatory intent.</li> <li>Support business teams in balancing commercial objectives with regulatory constraints through pragmatic, compliant solutions.</li> <li>Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on cross-border regulatory strategy.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>4. Control Design &amp; Governance</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design and implement regulatory controls for cross-border transactions, including:</li> <ul> <li>Transaction flow controls</li> <li>Regulatory limits and thresholds</li> <li>Reporting and reconciliation frameworks</li> </ul> <li>Establish governance frameworks covering policies, SOPs, regulatory attestations, and internal approvals.</li> <li>Ensure regulatory obligations are embedded into operational processes and system logic.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>5. Regulatory Engagement &amp; Audit Support</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Support regulatory inspections, audits, and supervisory interactions related to cross-border activities.</li> <li>Prepare responses to regulatory queries, inspection observations, and audit findings.</li> <li>Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely remediation and closure of regulatory observations.</li> <li>Assist in regulatory reporting and periodic submissions related to cross-border transactions.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>6. Stakeholder Management &amp; Communication</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as a central compliance point of contact for cross-border initiatives across teams.</li> <li>Communicate regulatory expectations clearly to non-compliance stakeholders.</li> <li>Escalate material regulatory risks appropriately with clear options and recommendations.</li> <li>Influence decision-making through structured, risk-based regulatory analysis.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Must-Have Qualifications &amp; Experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5–6 years of experience in <strong>regulatory compliance</strong>, must be in payments, fintech, banking, or financial services.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of:</li> <ul> <li>FEMA and RBI Master Directions</li> <li>Cross-border payment regulations</li> <li>FX and remittance frameworks</li> <li>LRS, export/import and international payment regulations, etc.</li> </ul> <li>Experience working with cross-functional teams such as Product, Legal, Operations, Risk, and Treasury.</li> <li>Hands-on experience in regulatory interpretation, advisory, and implementation.</li> <li>Exposure to regulatory audits, inspections, or supervisory interactions is highly desirable.</li> <li>Ability to translate complex regulations into practical, implementable business solutions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Good-to-Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience working in a global or multinational organization.</li> <li>Exposure to multiple jurisdictions or international regulatory frameworks.</li> <li>Experience with Payment Aggregators, AD-II entities, or card networks.</li> <li>Prior involvement in launching cross-border products or new regulated use cases.</li> <li>Certifications or qualifications in compliance, risk, or finance (e.g., CA, CIA, MBA, LLB, CAMS, etc.).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Key Skills &amp; Control Design &amp; Governance</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design and implement regulatory controls for cross-border transactions, including:</li> <ul> <li>Transaction flow controls</li> <li>Regulatory limits and thresholds</li> <li>Reporting and reconciliation frameworks</li> </ul> <li>Establish governance frameworks covering policies, SOPs, regulatory attestations, and internal approvals.</li> <li>Ensure regulatory obligations are embedded into operational processes and system logic.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>5. Regulatory Engagement &amp; Audit Support</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Support regulatory inspections, audits, and supervisory interactions related to cross-border activities.</li> <li>Prepare responses to regulatory queries, inspection observations, and audit findings.</li> <li>Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely remediation and closure of regulatory observations.</li> <li>Assist in regulatory reporting and periodic submissions related to cross-border transactions.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>6. Stakeholder Management &amp; Communication</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as a central compliance point of contact for cross-border initiatives across teams.</li> <li>Communicate regulatory expectations clearly to non-compliance stakeholders.</li> <li>Escalate material regulatory risks appropriately with clear options and recommendations.</li> <li>Influence decision-making through structured, risk-based regulatory analysis.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Must-Have Qualifications &amp; Experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5-6 years of experience in <strong>regulatory compliance</strong>, must be in payments, fintech, banking, or financial services.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of:</li> <ul> <li>FEMA and RBI Master Directions</li> <li>Cross-border payment regulations</li> <li>FX and remittance frameworks</li> <li>LRS, export/import and international payment regulations, etc.</li> </ul> <li>Experience working with cross-functional teams such as Product, Legal, Operations, Risk, and Treasury.</li> <li>Hands-on experience in regulatory interpretation, advisory, and implementation.</li> <li>Exposure to regulatory audits, inspections, or supervisory interactions is highly desirable.</li> <li>Ability to translate complex regulations into practical, implementable business solutions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Good-to-Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience working in a global or multinational organization.</li> <li>Exposure to multiple jurisdictions or international regulatory frameworks.</li> <li>Experience with Payment Aggregators, AD-II entities, or card networks.</li> <li>Prior involvement in launching cross-border products or new regulated use cases.</li> <li>Certifications or qualifications in compliance, risk, or finance (e.g., CA, CIA, MBA, LLB, CAMS, etc.).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Key Skills &amp; <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Phone Pe Limited:</strong></p> <p>Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the Phone Pe digital payments app, was launched in Aug
2016. As of April 2025, Phone Pe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. Phone Pe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Phone Pe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance,&nbsp;Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode
- hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus App Store Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India,&nbsp;which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to&nbsp;accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Culture:</strong></p> <p>At Phone Pe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. - Data Privacy</strong><br><br><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Job Description:</strong></span><br><br>We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Associate Manager to join our Data Privacy team. This role involves assisting in the development, implementation, and maintenance of our data privacy program. As an Associate Manager
- Data Privacy, you will help drive privacy initiatives and ensure organizational compliance with applicable data protection regulations, including India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA).&nbsp;The ideal candidate&nbsp;will have a strong understanding of data privacy laws, regulations and best practices, coupled&nbsp;with excellent communication, critical thinking, and analytical skills. On a day-to-day basis, you&nbsp;will be expected to leverage your expertise in privacy laws, concepts, and industry standards to&nbsp;understand and navigate complex environments and ensure robust privacy practices.<br><br><strong>Location:</strong> Bangalore, HQ, full-time<br><strong>Reports to:</strong> Senior Manager
- Data Privacy<br><strong>Function:</strong> Data Privacy | Ethics &amp; Compliance<br><br><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
</span><br></strong><br>● Assist in the development and implementation of privacy program components, including&nbsp;drafting and refining policies, procedures, and templates; assist in DPDPA&nbsp;implementation efforts<br>● Collaborate with business and product teams to assess and understand the&nbsp;organization’s use of personal data; serve as the key privacy advisor and point of&nbsp;contact for internal stakeholders, guiding privacy-related decisions.<br>● Research and monitor evolving privacy laws, regulations, and industry practices / trends,&nbsp;and analyse their impact on our business.<br>● Conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and risk assessments to&nbsp;proactively address and mitigate privacy risks.<br>● Enhance the organization’s existing consent management framework in alignment with&nbsp;legal and regulatory requirements, ensuring seamless integration across functions.<br>● Review privacy clauses in vendor contracts and ensure compliance with data protection&nbsp;requirements; provide assistance on the third-party risk management process to mitigate&nbsp;privacy risks.<br>● Help investigate and manage privacy incidents, including support with reporting and&nbsp;resolution.<br>● Support in handling data principal requests and ensure timely responses; assist in&nbsp;addressing queries related to data privacy rights and data protection practices.<br>● Assist with continuous monitoring and testing of existing privacy controls implemented&nbsp;across businesses, identify gaps, and initiate corrective measures.<br>● Assist with data discovery activities across the enterprise; ensure maintenance of&nbsp;personal data inventory.<br>● Assist with design and delivery of mandatory privacy training and role-specific&nbsp;awareness programs to increase privacy awareness.<br><br><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Qualifications and Requirements:</strong></span><br><br>● Bachelor’s / Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Law, Information Security, Privacy,&nbsp;or related fields<br>● 2-5 years of overall experience working in the Privacy domain<br>● In-depth knowledge of global privacy laws and frameworks, including GDPR, DPDPA,&nbsp;CCPA, Information Technology Act, and regulations from RBI, SEBI, IRDAI and other&nbsp;regulators<br>● Strong documentation and communication skills and proficiency with framework&nbsp;development, assessments, and policy and procedure documentation; jobDescription:
<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Phone Pe Limited:</strong></p> <p>Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the Phone Pe digital payments app, was launched in Aug
2016. As of April 2025, Phone Pe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. Phone Pe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Phone Pe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance,&nbsp;Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode
- hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus App Store Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India,&nbsp;which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to&nbsp;accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Culture:</strong></p> <p>At Phone Pe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right&nbsp; thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. Phone Pe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of&nbsp; the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!</p> <p><video controls="controls" width="300" height="150"> <source src="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mk Zstu Tl MFTM8s Dh1x4NYm7WSLueqklb/view?resourcekey"></video></p></div><h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <h3>1. Training Framework &amp; Compliance Management</h3> <ul> <li><strong>New Hire Onboarding:</strong> Design, develop, and execute comprehensive onboarding training programs for all new hires across telecalling and field collections.</li> <li><strong>Code of Conduct:</strong> Ensure 100% adherence to regulatory guidelines and Phone Pe’s strict internal collection code of conduct. Deliver exhaustive training to mitigate reputational and operational risks.</li> <li><strong>Refresher Programs:</strong> Plan and execute monthly refresher training sessions to update teams on process changes, new lending products, and updated negotiation or compliance strategies.</li> </ul> <h3>2. Quality Assurance &amp; Agency Governance</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Agency Monitoring:</strong> Partner with external Telecalling (TC) agencies to ensure they perform timely and accurate call quality evaluations as per agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).</li> <li><strong>Performance Calibration:</strong> Conduct regular calibration sessions with agency quality auditors to ensure alignment on evaluation parameters and scoring standards.</li> <li><strong>Performance Correction:</strong> Identify agents not meeting minimum quality standards and mandate targeted refresher programs to address specific skill gaps.</li> <li><strong>Disciplinary Framework:</strong> Implement a strict consequence management matrix, including the issuance of L1 and L2 warnings for repetitive compliance or quality offenders.</li> </ul> <h3>3. AI-Driven Analytics &amp; Insight Implementation</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Speech &amp; Text Analytics:</strong> Leverage our advanced AI-enabled call evaluation solution to analyze speech and text interactions at scale.</li> <li><strong>Insight Extraction:</strong> Transform raw data and automated metrics from the AI tool into actionable, workable insights regarding customer sentiment, objection handling, and agent behavior.</li> <li><strong>Core Training Integration:</strong> Feed AI-driven suggestions directly back into the core training curriculum to continuously optimize scripts, rebuttals, and collection methodologies.</li> <li><strong>Efficiency Optimization:</strong> Measure the direct impact of training interventions on overall collection efficiency, recovery rates, and customer experience.</li> </ul> <h3>4. Reporting &amp; Stakeholder Presentation</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Data Presentation:</strong> Synthesize quality scores, training completion rates, and AI insights into executive dashboards. Present findings clearly to the Collection Strategy Head and senior leadership. This would include tracking the performance of collection agents based on vintage/Hiring dates etc.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Work closely with Product, Engineering, Business and external vendors to align training objectives with business targets.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Required Qualifications &amp; Skills</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> Minimum of 5 years of proven experience explicitly managing Quality Assurance/Training operations within a lending or banking collections environment (Telecalling &amp; Field).</li> <li><strong>

EDUCATION:
</strong> A relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree from a recognized institution.</li> <li><strong>Communication Skills:</strong> Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. Candidate must be capable of delivering high-impact training and managing difficult compliance conversations.</li> <li><strong>Analytical &amp; Presentation Skills:</strong> Good analytics and and presentation skills</li> <li><strong>Technical Tech-Savviness:</strong> Prior exposure to or experience working with AI-enabled call monitoring systems, speech analytics tools, or automated QA platforms will be a plus.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Phone Pe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Insurance Benefits

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Phone Pe Limited:</strong></p> <p>Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the Phone Pe digital payments app, was launched in Aug
2016. As of April 2025, Phone Pe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. Phone Pe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Phone Pe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance,&nbsp;Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode
- hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus App Store Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India,&nbsp;which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to&nbsp;accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Culture:</strong></p> <p>At Phone Pe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. Phone Pe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of&nbsp; the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!</p> <p><video controls="controls" width="300" height="150"> <source src="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mk Zstu Tl MFTM8s Dh1x4NYm7WSLueqklb/view?resourcekey"></video></p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Job Description:</strong></h3> <p>The Share.Market Customer Experience Operations team is focused on addressing complex and advanced problems that our customers encounter while using our platform.</p> <p>As part of the Customer Support Specialists ) team, you will move beyond basic query handling to resolve high-stakes issues and manage critical escalations. You will look to understand customer pain points better and improve customer experience by working with internal product, tech, and compliance teams to forge robust, timely solutions. Customer Experience Operations in stockbroking offers a dynamic landscape of varied challenges, given the nature of market volatility and financial transactions. This offers us a significant opportunity to develop deep domain expertise and challenge ourselves as we advance in our careers.</p> <h3><strong>Role

RESPONSIBILITIES:
</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own the Customer Experience:</strong> Act with deep integrity and think customer-first in every interaction, particularly when handling complex or sensitive issues.</li> <li><strong>Manage High Interaction Tickets (HIT):</strong> Take full ownership of and resolve High Interaction Tickets (HIT)—issues requiring multi-touch communication, in-depth investigation, or personalized care.</li> <li><strong>Resolve L1 Escalations:</strong> Efficiently address and resolve issues escalated by L1 agents, serving as the definitive resolver for complex non-tech inquiries.</li> <li><strong>Ensure SLA Adherence:</strong> Manage your queue diligently to ensure all customers' tickets are closed within the stipulated Service Level Agreements (SLAs).</li> <li><strong>Handle Tech Dependencies:</strong> In cases of technical dependencies, escalate promptly to the appropriate product or engineering stakeholder, following up rigorously until resolution is achieved and communicated to the customer.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrate Ownership &amp; Rigor:</strong> Display exceptional execution rigor and ownership by managing the end-to-end resolution of complex issues, leaving no stone unturned.</li> <li><strong>Process Improvement:</strong> Recommend process improvements based on root cause analysis of frequent escalations to reduce ticket volume.</li> <li><strong>Documentation:</strong> Maintain meticulous documentation of escalated cases for reporting and compliance purposes.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Experience, Skills,

QUALIFICATIONS:
</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Multilingual Skills:</strong> Ability to speak fluently in English and Hindi is essential.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex financial or market concepts clearly.</li> <li><strong>Ownership:</strong> Proven ability to take full responsibility for outcomes and drive issues to completion.</li> <li><strong>Rigorous Execution:</strong> Detail-oriented with strong prioritization and time-management skills to maintain performance in a high-pressure environment.</li> <li><strong>Problem Solver:</strong> Be an active listener with a strong customer orientation and the ability to adapt/respond to different scenarios.</li> <li><strong>Bonus Skills (Preferred):</strong> Prior experience in Stockbroking Operations, a strong understanding of financial markets, or experience in a senior Customer Experience role.</li> <li><strong>Technical Bonus:</strong> Basic knowledge of Excel and/or SQL for data retrieval and analysis is a significant plus.</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>

Graduation (10+2+3) is mandatory. NISM certifications (e.g., Series VI, VII) are mandatory.</strong></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Phone Pe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Insurance Benefits

- </strong>Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><em>Our inclusive culture promotes individual expression, creativity, innovation, and achievement and in turn helps us better understand and serve our customers. title: Head of Design, Wealth
jobDescription:
<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Phone Pe Limited:</strong></p> <p>Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the Phone Pe digital payments app, was launched in Aug
2016. As of April 2025, Phone Pe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. Phone Pe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Phone Pe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance,&nbsp;Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode
- hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus App Store Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India,&nbsp;which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to&nbsp;accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Culture:</strong></p> <p>At Phone Pe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right&nbsp; thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. Phone Pe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of&nbsp; the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!</p> <p><video controls="controls" width="300" height="150"> <source src="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mk Zstu Tl MFTM8s Dh1x4NYm7WSLueqklb/view?resourcekey"></video></p></div><p><strong>Why Phone Pe:</strong></p> <p>At Phone Pe our vision is to provide financial inclusion to a billion Indians. Today we have made significant progress on this vision by making digital payments far simpler and ubiquitous than it has ever been. However we wish to make it so easy, safe, and universally accepted that people never feel the need to carry cash or cards again. And not just in Urban India. At Phone Pe, our aim to transform the entire Indian landscape so that every Indian, in every corner of the country, makes significant economic progress. Onwards and upwards! That is our goal.</p> <p><strong>Why Phone Pe Design:</strong></p> <p>If you are sold on the vision of the company, you may want to consider the design team as a place to make this a reality. The design team at Phone Pe is a bunch of creative trailblazers who are leading the effort to make a dent in the fintech universe. The design team consists of Product Designers, Visual Designers, Graphic &amp; Motion Designers, and Illustrators who are all engaged in blending art and science into a promising value proposition for our users.</p> <h2><strong>About Share.Market</strong></h2> <p><a href="https://www.share.market/">Share.Market</a> is how Phone Pe is rebuilding trading and investing for India. It's a full-stack broking platform — stocks, F&amp;O, ETFs, mutual funds, IPOs, and Wealth Baskets — with a research and intelligence layer (factor analysis on every stock, expert-curated baskets) sitting on top. It's a separate app from the main Phone Pe one, and it's backed by Phone Pe's reach, trust, and distribution.</p> <p>This is a hard, interesting design problem. You're working with regulated financial products, real money, and a spectrum of users that runs from a first-time investor buying their first stock to an active trader running F&amp;O strategies. The job is to make something genuinely powerful feel calm and trustworthy — not to bolt more features onto a busy screen.</p> <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p>You'll own design for Share.Market end to end. Today that means you, the craft, and a close partnership with product and engineering — this is a hands-on leadership role, not a manage-from-a-distance one. As the product grows, you'll build and lead the team around it.</p> <p>You'll set the design direction, ship the work yourself when it matters, and be the person accountable for the quality of the experience. You'll report to the Head of Design (Phone Pe Group) and work alongside the broader Phone Pe design org, but Share.Market's design is yours to own.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own the experience.</strong> Set the bar for what good looks like on Share.Market, and hold it. Strategy, flows, visual craft, microcopy — you're accountable for all of it.</li> <li><strong>Ship, don't just direct.</strong> Get into the file. Design the hard screens yourself. Prototype to find the answer rather than arguing about it in a doc.</li> <li><strong>Make complex things simple.</strong> Turn dense financial data and regulated flows into something a first-time investor trusts and a serious trader respects. This is the core craft of the job.</li> <li><strong>Partner closely.</strong> Work shoulder to shoulder with product and engineering as an equal. Bring the user's point of view to roadmap and tradeoff conversations early, not at the end.</li> <li><strong>Build the team.</strong> As Share.Market grows, manage and grow the designers around you, and set the standards they'll work to.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we're looking for</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>12+ years in product design</strong>, with real ownership of consumer products at scale. Some of that as a lead, whether managing people or anchoring quality for a product.</li> <li><strong>Proven craft.</strong> A portfolio that shows depth, not just breadth — interaction design, visual polish, and clear thinking about why each decision was made.</li> <li><strong>Domain knowledge is a strong advantage.</strong> This is a genuinely complex space — broking, F&amp;O, market structure, the way regulation shapes every flow. If you've worked in trading, broking, or wealth, or you invest seriously yourself and understand it from the inside, that's a real head start. Not a hard requirement, but it counts for a lot.</li> <li><strong>Comfort with complexity.</strong> You've designed for data-heavy or regulated products — fintech, trading, health, anything where the details are hard and the stakes are real. Or you can show us you'll get there fast.</li> <li><strong>Systems thinking.</strong> You design with the whole product in mind, not one screen at a time. You're fluent with design systems and know when to extend one versus break from it.</li> <li><strong>Strong written and verbal communication.</strong> You can write clear microcopy, make a tight argument for a direction, and give direct, useful feedback.</li> <li><strong>Player-coach instinct.</strong> You're senior enough to lead and still want your hands on the work.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we care about</strong></h2> <p>We hire and grow people around three things: <strong>craft, context, and community.</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Craft</strong> — the quality of the work and the attention to detail behind it.</li> <li><strong>Context</strong> — understanding the bigger picture: the user, the business, the system you're part of.</li> <li><strong>Community</strong> — building the people and the relationships around the work, not just the work itself.</li> </ul> <p>We believe in subtractive design: the best version of a financial product usually has less in it, not more. We'd rather remove the right thing than add another feature. If that resonates, you'll like it here.</p> <h2><strong>Why this matters</strong></h2> <h3><sup>Most Indians have never owned a stock. The ones who do often find investing intimidating, opaque, or built for someone more sophisticated than they feel. Getting this right means more people participating in the country's growth, with confidence and without getting burned. That's the work.</sup><br><br><strong>Design Microsite : </strong><a href="https://design.phonepe.com/">https://design.phonepe.com/</a></h3><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Phone Pe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Insurance Benefits

2016. As of April 2025, Phone Pe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. Phone Pe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Phone Pe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance,&nbsp;Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode
- hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus App Store Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India,&nbsp;which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to&nbsp;accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Culture:</strong></p> <p>At Phone Pe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right&nbsp; thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. Phone Pe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of&nbsp; the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!</p> <p><video controls="controls" width="300" height="150"> <source src="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mk Zstu Tl MFTM8s Dh1x4NYm7WSLueqklb/view?resourcekey"></video></p></div><p><strong>Reporting To:</strong> Head – People Experience</p> <p><strong>Role Overview:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a <strong>Lead People Experience</strong> to own and<strong> </strong>scale end-to-end employee lifecycle operations for a large, distributed, feet-on-street workforce with high monthly churn, ensuring accuracy, speed, compliance, and cost efficiency. The role is critical in enabling uninterrupted business operations through robust onboarding, offboarding, payroll and statutory compliance, particularly in a piece-rate compensation environment.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong> Employee Lifecycle Management</strong></li> </ul> <ul> <li>Own and continuously improve end-to-end lifecycle processes, including:</li> <ul> <li>Offer issuance and acceptance at scale</li> <li>Bulk onboarding and induction readiness</li> <li>Background verification (BGV) initiation, tracking, and closure</li> <li>Data integrity across HRMS, payroll, and compliance systems</li> <li>Exit processing, final settlements, and statutory closures</li> </ul> <li>Ensure lifecycle SLAs are met despite high daily transaction volumes.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong> High-Volume Onboarding &amp; Workforce Readiness</strong></li> </ul> <ul> <li>Design and operate bulk hiring and onboarding models capable of handling ~1,000 joiners per week.</li> <li>Ensure seamless coordination between recruitment, business HR, HRMS, payroll, and compliance teams</li> <li>Drive standardisation of documentation and exception handling for ensuring deployment-readiness from Day 1</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong> FTC Management&nbsp;</strong></li> </ul> <ul> <li>Own the entire lifecycle processes for the fixed-term contract employees on third party payroll.</li> <li>Guide the team for timely payroll and F&amp;F process for disbursements and the required vendor compliances.</li> <li>Oversee process alignment, adherence and exception management with Business HR team, Finance team and Compliance team.</li> <li>Review of the vendor (third party payroll provider) and their performance evaluation on process and compliance adherence.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong> Statutory Compliance &amp; Remittances</strong></li> </ul> <ul> <li>Ensure full compliance across central and state labour laws, including&nbsp;</li> <ul> <li>Registrations and remittances for EPF, ESI, PT, LWF</li> <li>Adherence to the Minimum Wages (time-rate floors in piece-rate scenarios)</li> <li>CLRA (in cases of third party roll employees) and state-specific registrations</li> <li>Timely statutory filings, challans, and remittances</li> </ul> <li>Own audit readiness for internal, statutory, and external audits.</li> <ul> <li>Partner closely with Legal, Finance, and Internal Audit for supporting the audit processes</li> </ul> </ul> <ul> <li><strong> Vendor &amp; Partner Management</strong></li> </ul> <ul> <li>Manage multiple vendors across:</li> <ul> <li>Payroll processing</li> <li>Background verification</li> <li>Compliance filings</li> </ul> <li>Define clear SLAs, KPIs, and penalty structures for meeting timelines and quality</li> <li>Drive cost optimisation without compromising compliance or employee experience</li> <li>Ensure vendor scalability aligns with business growth and churn dynamics</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong> Technology &amp; Process Excellence</strong></li> </ul> <ul> <li>Leverage HRMS, payroll systems, attendance/productivity tools, and automation</li> <li>Drive digitisation and straight-through processing wherever possible</li> <li>Continuously improve TATs, reduce manual effort, and enhance scalability</li> <li>Ensure systems can handle extreme transaction volumes without failure</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong> Process Leadership and Team Management</strong></li> </ul> <ul> <li>Provide in-depth guidance to the team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and functional expertise.</li> <li>Act as a functional expert within HR Operations, bringing deep expertise and a point of view on the broader business landscape.</li> <li>Lead a multi-layered operations team and fostering a culture of rigor, ownership, and continuous improvement</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Qualifications &amp; Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>12+ years of progressive experience in HR Operations, Shared Services, or Payroll Management with a proven track record of handling high-volume, blue-collar, or salesforce (preferably 15,000+ headcount).</li> <li>Deep functional expertise in managing the full employee lifecycle and high-stakes statutory compliance (registrations, remittances) in India.</li> <li>Proven experience in designing and executing scalable, automated solutions for payroll and BGV in a high-attrition environment.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving and exception-handling capability</li> <li>Data-driven decision making</li> <li>MBA / PG Diploma in HR or equivalent is preferred.</li> <li>High proficiency in MS Excel</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Phone Pe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Insurance Benefits
- </strong>Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance</li> <li><strong>Wellness Program -</strong> Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System</li> <li><strong>Parental Support
- </strong>Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program</li> <li><strong>Mobility Benefits
- </strong>Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy</li> <li><strong>Retirement Benefits
- </strong>Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Other Benefits
- </strong>Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><em>Our inclusive culture promotes individual expression, creativity, innovation, and achievement and in turn helps us better understand and serve our customers. We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity,&nbsp; ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. Phone Pe is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to treating all its employees and job applicants equally; regardless of&nbsp; gender, sexual preference, religion, race, color or disability. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or reasonable accommodation, during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, </em></strong><a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIp QLSc-ETchy2Ls Q_Djl NXOUc Gf I182Dn A533YZTLf Vw5Tk JH-Stw/viewform"><strong><em>please fill out this form.</em></strong></a></p> <p><strong><em>Read more about Phone Pe</em></strong><a href="https://www.phonepe.com/blog/"><strong><em> on our blog</em></strong></a><strong><em>.</em></strong></p> <p><a href="https://www.phonepe.com/blog/life-at-phonepe/"><strong>Life at Phone Pe</strong></a></p> <p><a href="https://www.phonepe.com/press/"><strong>Phone Pe in the news</strong></a></p></div>

</strong></p> </div> </div> <div class="p-pdf_iframe__page" data-page-number="2"> <div class="text Layer" style="padding-left: 40px;" data-main-rotation="0"> <ul> <li>Bachelor Engineering&nbsp; in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.</li> <li>1-3 years of experience in network operations, network engineering or a related&nbsp;role.</li> <li>Familiarity&nbsp;with Data Center topologies and network routing and switching concepts like BGP, OSPF, VLAN, VRRP, etc. Knowledge of Vx LAN will be an added advantage</li> <li>Basic scripting and automation skills, with entry-level proficiency in languages like&nbsp;Python, Go, Shell and orchestration tools like Ansible, Salt or similar.</li> <li>Basic fundamental knowledge of Linux esp. jobDescription:
<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Phone Pe Limited:</strong></p> <p>Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the Phone Pe digital payments app, was launched in Aug
2016. As of April 2025, Phone Pe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. Phone Pe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Phone Pe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance,&nbsp;Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode
- hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus App Store Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India,&nbsp;which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to&nbsp;accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Culture:</strong></p> <p>At Phone Pe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right&nbsp; thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. Phone Pe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of&nbsp; the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!</p> <p><video controls="controls" width="300" height="150"> <source src="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mk Zstu Tl MFTM8s Dh1x4NYm7WSLueqklb/view?resourcekey"></video></p></div><p><strong>About Phone Pe</strong></p> <p>Phone Pe is India’s leading digital payments platform with over 700 million registered users and 50 million registered merchants. Using Phone Pe, users can send and receive money, recharge mobile, DTH, data cards, pay at stores, make utility payments, buy gold, and make investments. Phone Pe went live for customers in August 2016 and was the first non-banking UPI app and offered money transfer to individuals and merchants, recharges and bill payments to begin with. Phone Pe is one of the leading payments providers for merchants in India. Phone Pe provides digital payments for offline merchants as well as online merchants.</p> <p><strong>Opportunity:</strong></p> <p>Phone Pe is on a mission to change the landscape of digital payments and financial services in India. On this mission, we are committed to hiring the best while creating an environment of equal opportunity and empowerment. As an Associate Director of Product at Phone Pe, you will own and drive the roadmap for our payment solutions and devices products for offline merchants. You will work with other pod members and a diverse set of stakeholders towards a collective set of objectives. We work on complex technology, scale while iterating quickly and have a bias for impact in everything we do.&nbsp;</p> <p>Leading our Offline Payment Solutions and devices product portfolio, you will be working with leaders in the offline merchant business unit to determine the portfolio product strategy. You will be responsible for evangelizing and aligning all the cross-functional stakeholders on the strategy and plans and work on the execution and delivery to realize the identified opportunity and impact.</p> <p><strong>Culture:</strong></p> <p>At Phone Pe, we take extra care to make sure you give your best at work, Everyday! And creating the right&nbsp; environment for you is just one of the things we do. We empower people and trust them to do the right&nbsp; thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. Being enthusiastic about tech is a&nbsp; big part of being at Phone Pe. If you like building technology that impacts millions, ideating with some of&nbsp; the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!</p> <p><strong>As an Associate Director of Product/ Product Lead, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Defines a portfolio product strategy from first principles that becomes the org’s reference point; drives multi-pod execution and measurable portfolio outcomes</li> <li>Identifies and delivers multiple Annual Operating Plan-shaping bets; consistently makes correct profitability vs growth calls across portfolio, shifts business trajectory with durable levers (pricing, distribution, unit economics, cost-to-serve)</li> <li>Designs pod-level org structure and capability plan that materially increases throughput and quality; shapes cross-functional Hiring AOP with high accuracy; prevents bottlenecks before they form.</li> <li>Builds a strong leadership bench; direct reports consistently progress levels. Establishes pod-wide talent mechanisms with counterparts that raise performance across functions.</li> <li>Designs and evolves the pod operating system (planning, decision forums, execution reviews, launch readiness, learning loops) with measurable improvements in reliability and speed.</li> <li>Demonstrate thought leadership and be the go to person for product decisions for internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Engage with external customers and stakeholders, communicate objectives and progress.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excellent communication skills.</li> <li>At least 10+ years of experience in Product / Platform building and development.</li> <li>Strong business acumen and ability to partner with cross-functional teams.</li> <li>Contributes to business decisions regularly and proactively.</li> <li>Can build credibility via knowledge and judgment to persuade others.</li> <li>Conducts interviews for PM/SPM roles and for specific competencies.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Phone Pe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Insurance Benefits
- </strong>Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance</li> <li><strong>Wellness Program -</strong> Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System</li> <li><strong>Parental Support
- </strong>Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program</li> <li><strong>Mobility Benefits
- </strong>Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy</li> <li><strong>Retirement Benefits
- </strong>Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Other Benefits
- </strong>Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><em>Our inclusive culture promotes individual expression, creativity, innovation, and achievement and in turn helps us better understand and serve our customers. We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity,&nbsp; ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. Phone Pe is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to treating all its employees and job applicants equally; regardless of&nbsp; gender, sexual preference, religion, race, color or disability. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or reasonable accommodation, during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, </em></strong><a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIp QLSc-ETchy2Ls Q_Djl NXOUc Gf I182Dn A533YZTLf Vw5Tk JH-Stw/viewform"><strong><em>please fill out this form.</em></strong></a></p> <p><strong><em>Read more about Phone Pe</em></strong><a href="https://www.phonepe.com/blog/"><strong><em> on our blog</em></strong></a><strong><em>.</em></strong></p> <p><a href="https://www.phonepe.com/blog/life-at-phonepe/"><strong>Life at Phone Pe</strong></a></p> <p><a href="https://www.phonepe.com/press/"><strong>Phone Pe in the news</strong></a></p></div>

</h3> <p>Phone Pe's Data Platform powers India's largest consumer payments app at national scale—managing petabyte-scale infrastructure, batch/real-time pipelines, and developer tooling entirely on-premise. ONE of: Hive/Spark/Hadoop/HDFS, Snowflake/Databricks/Big Query, or Airflow/DBT/Kafka/Trino&nbsp;</li> <li>Understands how data systems work end-to-end (not just BI layer)</li> </ol> <li>Problem-First Thinking</li> <ol> <li>Asks clarifying questions before solutions (WHO, WHAT, WHEN, WHY, HOW)&nbsp;</li> <li>Articulates problems → solutions → outcomes (not feature lists)&nbsp;</li> <li>Synthesizes requirements from diverse stakeholders into clear product specs</li> </ol> <li>Structured Approach</li> <ol> <li>Breaks down ambiguous problems systematically</li> <li>States assumptions explicitly and validates them</li> <li>Thinks in MVP phases and iterations</li> </ol> <li>Technical Communication</li> <ol> <li>Holds technical discussions with engineers/architects</li> <li>Translates business needs into system specs, APIs, and developer interfaces</li> <li>Writes clear PRDs, specs, and documentation</li> </ol> </ol> <h3>Good To Haves:</h3> <ul> <li>TB/PB-scale data systems experience</li> governance: cataloging, lineage, access controls, metadata management, observability</li> <li>AI-native workflow: Active user of Chat GPT/Claude/Git Hub Copilot; bonus for Gen AI features (RAG, LLM apps)</li> <li>High-potential signals: Published work, side projects, led cross-functional teams</li> </ul> <h3>Why Join?</h3> <ul> <li>Unmatched scale: Petabyte-scale data infrastructure, real-time pipelines at national scale</li> <li>Open-source stack: Massive on-premise deployments (Hive, Spark, HDFS, Hadoop)</li> <li>High impact: Enable every engineering, analytics, and business team to move - Understanding of Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) using Salt or Ansible</li> <li>Database Concepts &amp; Administration
- Understanding of Shards, Partitions and Truncations</li> <li>Bash / Python Scripting
- Proficiency in writing and debugging Bash / Python Scripts</li> </ul> <p><strong>Knowledge of the following will be a plus</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maria DB or similar Distributed Database Systems</li> <li>Docker or similar Containerization technology</li> <li>Nginx or similar Proxy technology</li> <li>GIT</li> <li>Basic Networking Concepts</li> <li>Linux-based Firewall</li> <li>Basic understanding of HTTP &amp; TLS Security</li> <li>Ability to write Python based scripts for various automations</li> </ul> <p>Softskills:</p> <ul> <li>Good Interpersonal Communication Skills</li> <li>Ability to understand &amp; follow SOPs</li> </ul> <p>

</p> <ul> <li>Minimum of 1-3 years of hands-on experience in Linux / Unix System Administration.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Work Location: Bangalore</p> <p>Note: This role requires the candidate to be available for on-call shifts on a rotational&nbsp;basis, covering 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Phone Pe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Insurance Benefits

And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right&nbsp; thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. Phone Pe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of&nbsp; the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!</p> <p><video controls="controls" width="300" height="150"> <source src="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mk Zstu Tl MFTM8s Dh1x4NYm7WSLueqklb/view?resourcekey"></video></p></div><h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are building an in-house team to maintain and contribute to our internal Apache Kafka distribution. This is not an operations role — you will work on the Kafka codebase itself: the broker, the KRaft controller, the protocol, the clients, and the storage layer. You will be our technical anchor for all things Kafka internals, driving upstream contributions, backporting critical fixes, and shaping our internal distribution to meet the needs of a large-scale production fleet.</p> <p>We already do this successfully with Gluster FS, where we maintain an in-house distribution backed by deep upstream expertise. We want to replicate that model for Kafka.</p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Own our internal Kafka distribution: branch management, patch curation, release cutting, upgrade planning</li> <li>Contribute upstream to Apache Kafka — bug fixes, KIPs, code reviews, design discussions</li> <li>Diagnose and fix deep broker/controller issues: replication, partition reassignment, KRaft consensus, log storage, ISR management, protocol handling</li> <li>Build custom patches for production needs that aren't suitable for upstream (performance tuning for our workload profile, observability hooks, operational safety valves)</li> <li>Establish engineering practices for Kafka development within the team: how we test, how we benchmark, how we validate patches before rolling them out</li> <li>Mentor a supporting engineer and grow the team's capability over time</li> <li>Act as the internal authority on Kafka internals — advise platform teams on configuration, capacity planning, and architectural decisions that require knowledge of broker behavior</li> <li>Act as the primary interface for audit and compliance teams, ensuring Phone Pe Kafka distribution meets various compliance and regulatory standards</li> </ul> <h2>What are we looking for?</h2> <ul> <li>Deep familiarity with the Kafka codebase — you have read, modified, and debugged the broker, controller, or client internals. Not just operated Kafka, but worked on it.</li> <li>Track record of upstream contribution — committed patches, participated in KIP discussions, reviewed PRs, or equivalent engagement with the Apache Kafka community. Active committer/PMC status is strongly preferred but not strictly required if your contribution history demonstrates equivalent depth.</li> <li>Strong distributed systems fundamentals — consensus protocols, replication, exactly-once semantics, log-structured storage, distributed state machines. A world-class video is useless if no one clicks on it, and you are the person who ensures they do. Your job is to take the core hook of a video and turn it into a high-impact visual that stands out in a crowded feed. You will work in an AI-first environment, using generative tools to create assets and variations that would take hours to build by hand.</p> <p><strong>Focus Area 1: Visual Storytelling and CTR Optimization</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>You own the "click."</p> <ul> <li>You design thumbnails that tell a story in a split second. You understand how to use composition, contrast, and color theory to guide the viewer’s eye exactly where you want it.</li> <li>You are a master of "The Hook." You know how to pair a compelling image with minimal text to create curiosity or urgency.</li> <li>You manage facial expressions and emotive triggers. You know how to select or generate the perfect "hero" image that connects with a human audience.</li> <li>You work closely with the Channel Intelligence Lead to analyze A/B test results and refine your designs based on actual performance data.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Focus Area 2: AI-First Composition and Workflow</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>You use the machine to outpace the competition.</p> <ul> <li>You are a power user of generative AI tools like Midjourney, DALL-E 3, or Stable Diffusion to create unique assets, backgrounds, and characters from scratch.</li> <li>You use the latest AI features in Photoshop (like Generative Fill and Expand) to manipulate images, swap elements, and clean up compositions in seconds.</li> <li>You build and maintain a library of AI-generated assets that allow us to move from a concept to a finished thumbnail in record time.</li> <li>You stay ahead of the curve. When a new AI model or technique drops that can improve our visual quality or speed, you are the first to master it.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Focus Area 3: Iteration and Data-Driven Design</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>You don't just make one version; you build a system for winning.</p> <ul> <li>You produce multiple variations for every video. You understand that the first idea isn't always the best, and you use AI to quickly test different angles, colors, and compositions.</li> <li>You are obsessed with the "why" behind the click. You look at CTR (Click-Through Rate) data and qualified view metrics to understand which visual styles are resonating with our specific audience.</li> <li>You ensure brand consistency. While every thumbnail is an experiment, you make sure the overall "look" of the channel remains premium and recognizable.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Are Looking For</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Agility:</strong> You are a master of the Adobe Suite and a power user of generative AI. You don't get hung up on tools; you use whatever gets the best result the fastest.</li> <li><strong>Attention to Detail:</strong> You have an eye for lighting, shadows, and perspective. You ensure that AI-generated elements blend perfectly into the final composition so they never look "fake."</li> <li><strong>Speed without sacrificing quality:</strong> You thrive on high-volume output. You can turn around multiple high-end thumbnails in a single day without the quality ever dipping.</li> <li><strong>Analytical Thinking:</strong> You don't just "feel" that a design is good. You look at the data and can explain why a certain visual is likely to perform better.</li> <li><strong>High Ownership:</strong> You treat the CTR of every video as your personal responsibility. If a video is underperforming, you are already building a new thumbnail before anyone asks.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Phone Pe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Insurance Benefits

Your job is to decode the trading community’s unique psychology and use platform data to scale our viewership. You move at the speed of the market ticker.</p> <ul> <li> <p>You monitor live market catalysts, open interest shifts, option chain data, and technical setups to identify breaking content opportunities within minutes.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You translate complex technical analysis, derivative strategies, or macro announcements into high-impact, immediate concepts for our scriptwriters.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You run AI-powered social listening tools across financial platforms, specialized forums, and trading communities to catch retail sentiment shifts before they explode on You Tube.</p> </li> </ul> <p>You coordinate with the production team for rapid-response videos, ensuring we publish while market volume and volatility are still peaking.</p> <p>Focus Area 2: F&amp;O Psychology &amp; Advanced Retention Mechanics&nbsp;</p> <p>You know exactly what makes a serious, active market participant click and watch.</p> <ul> <li> <p>You optimize for the specific psychological triggers of the derivative community: risk management, position sizing, leverage, volatility, and the search for a definitive edge.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You design hook structures that establish immediate analytical authority, keeping viewers locked in through complex technical setups without losing pacing.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You build a distinct packaging strategy for active trading content: utilizing clean chart patterns, clear data overlays, and high-intent thumbnail concepts that command attention on a crowded screen.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You guide the editing team on the pacing of technical breakdowns, ensuring that option strategies and chart analysis are snappy, visually engaging, and highly scannable.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Focus Area 3: Algorithmic Agility &amp; Real-Time Channel Management&nbsp;</p> <p>You manage the channel like an active portfolio.</p> <ul> <li> <p>You monitor immediate velocity metrics: tracking click-through rates (CTR) and view-count acceleration within the critical first two hours of an upload.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You leverage You Tube Community posts, polls, and live alerts to keep the audience highly engaged around expiry days, market openings, and critical economic data releases.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You optimize live stream metrics, managing real-time engagement, interactive charts, and viewer retention during high-impact market hours.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You collaborate with the Creative Project Manager to dynamically pivot the content backlog based on daily market performance and viewer drop-off zones.<br><br></p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Are Looking For</strong></p> <p>Deep Derivative Literacy: You possess a strong understanding of F&amp;O mechanics, trading psychology, and technical analysis. You know how to extract actionable video concepts from raw platform metrics.</p> <p>Platform Mastery: 3 to 5 years of experience scaling hyper-engaged You Tube channels, specifically within the finance, equity markets, or active trading niches.</p> <p>Speed with High Precision: You thrive in high-pressure environments where getting an accurate, high-quality analysis out in two hours beats getting a perfect video out tomorrow.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Mindset to Succeed</strong></p> <p>Market-Driven: You love the energy of active markets. You know exactly how to structure titles and thumbnails that address their market concerns or validate their strategies.</p> <p>Data-Obsessed: You do not guess what content works. You let the retention graphs, traffic sources, and performance data dictate the channel's next tactical move.</p> <p>Automation-First: You embrace the automated factory.
