experienceProfile.rawText: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Phone Pe Limited:</strong></p> <p>Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the Phone Pe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016. As of April 2025, Phone Pe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. Phone Pe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Phone Pe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance,&nbsp;Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode - hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus App Store Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India,&nbsp;which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to&nbsp;accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Culture:</strong></p> <p>At Phone Pe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right&nbsp; thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. Phone Pe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of&nbsp; the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!</p> <p><video controls="controls" width="300" height="150"> <source src="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mk Zstu Tl MFTM8s Dh1x4NYm7WSLueqklb/view?resourcekey"></video></p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About The Role&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>You are the algorithmic brain behind our highest-velocity financial property. This channel caters to active, serious investors focused on Futures and Options (F&amp;O), technical analysis, and market momentum. Your job is to decode the trading community’s unique psychology and use platform data to scale our viewership. You understand open interest, option chains, chart literacy, and the analytical mindset required to navigate the markets. Operating in our AI-first factory, you will use data models and automated scraping to spot macro trends and derivative catalysts before they hit the retail feed.</p> <p>Focus Area 1: Derivative Market Trend Hunting &amp; Catalyst Capture&nbsp;</p> <p>You don't wait for traditional planning cycles. You move at the speed of the market ticker.</p> <ul> <li> <p>You monitor live market catalysts, open interest shifts, option chain data, and technical setups to identify breaking content opportunities within minutes.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You translate complex technical analysis, derivative strategies, or macro announcements into high-impact, immediate concepts for our scriptwriters.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You run AI-powered social listening tools across financial platforms, specialized forums, and trading communities to catch retail sentiment shifts before they explode on You Tube.</p> </li> </ul> <p>You coordinate with the production team for rapid-response videos, ensuring we publish while market volume and volatility are still peaking.</p> <p>Focus Area 2: F&amp;O Psychology &amp; Advanced Retention Mechanics&nbsp;</p> <p>You know exactly what makes a serious, active market participant click and watch.</p> <ul> <li> <p>You optimize for the specific psychological triggers of the derivative community: risk management, position sizing, leverage, volatility, and the search for a definitive edge.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You design hook structures that establish immediate analytical authority, keeping viewers locked in through complex technical setups without losing pacing.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You build a distinct packaging strategy for active trading content: utilizing clean chart patterns, clear data overlays, and high-intent thumbnail concepts that command attention on a crowded screen.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You guide the editing team on the pacing of technical breakdowns, ensuring that option strategies and chart analysis are snappy, visually engaging, and highly scannable.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Focus Area 3: Algorithmic Agility &amp; Real-Time Channel Management&nbsp;</p> <p>You manage the channel like an active portfolio.</p> <ul> <li> <p>You monitor immediate velocity metrics: tracking click-through rates (CTR) and view-count acceleration within the critical first two hours of an upload.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You leverage You Tube Community posts, polls, and live alerts to keep the audience highly engaged around expiry days, market openings, and critical economic data releases.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You optimize live stream metrics, managing real-time engagement, interactive charts, and viewer retention during high-impact market hours.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You collaborate with the Creative Project Manager to dynamically pivot the content backlog based on daily market performance and viewer drop-off zones.<br><br></p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Are Looking For</strong></p> <p>Deep Derivative Literacy: You possess a strong understanding of F&amp;O mechanics, trading psychology, and technical analysis. You know how to extract actionable video concepts from raw platform metrics.</p> <p>Platform Mastery: 3 to 5 years of experience scaling hyper-engaged You Tube channels, specifically within the finance, equity markets, or active trading niches.</p> <p>Speed with High Precision: You thrive in high-pressure environments where getting an accurate, high-quality analysis out in two hours beats getting a perfect video out tomorrow.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Mindset to Succeed</strong></p> <p>Market-Driven: You love the energy of active markets.
